rev6.release_notes: G-SEND.IO opens maximized every time. Tool Definitions: the mouse wheel no longer changes values by accident, and MILL CUTTER tools show as a face mill.

cadcam.release_notes: The gap warning is fixed: a part only warns when a gap is really there (over 0.0005"), and an imported part's tiny gaps are shown in its hover, not as a warning. The 3D drawing view and Section View work again. Drill Chart: a click picks a size, a double-click fills it in. Bolt circles get a diameter circle you can pull and a start angle you can turn. 2D Contour leads snap to segment ends and can be arcs. Every toolpath pick lights up under the mouse; Alt picks one segment. Soft jaws. Square corners on new 2D Contours and Pockets (on by default). The view cube takes a typed angle and snaps by 5 degrees. The 3D sheet view turns, tilts and orbits freely; a double-click on the paper lays it flat. Many fixes from ENGINE TEST run 7. Parts saved by this version use file format 6; an older version opens them read-only.
